# Applications

> Practical browser-based tools and games. Search the workspace, then open any application in your browser.

This file is an index of the public pages of the applications workspace. It is an
entry list for language-model and AI crawlers, kept alongside the HTML pages. Every
link is absolute; the canonical address of a tool is its root-level route, for example
https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/markdown-editor/.

## Workspace

- [Applications](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/): Practical browser-based tools and games. Search the workspace, then open any application in your browser.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy Policy for app.sergeyromanenko.com: browser-local processing, files, storage, service workers, third-party requests and your rights.
- [Terms of Use](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/terms-of-use/): Terms of Use for app.sergeyromanenko.com: permitted use of the tools and games, user responsibilities, disclaimers, availability and intellectual property.
- [Copyright & Licensing](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/copyright-and-licensing/): Copyright, ownership and licensing information for the applications, games, interfaces, assets and documentation published on app.sergeyromanenko.com.

## Applications

- [Markdown Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/markdown-editor/): Write Markdown, preview beautifully rendered HTML in real time, and export high-quality PNG images with customizable scale, padding, backgrounds, and styling.
- [Text Analyzer](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/text-analyzer/): Measure words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time, page count, word frequency and repeated phrases — computed entirely in your browser.
- [Case Converter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/case-converter/): Convert text to uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and eleven more formats at once.
- [Text Cleaner](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/text-cleaner/): Clean text pasted from a web page, PDF or spreadsheet — collapse whitespace, fix line endings, find invisible characters and strip HTML.
- [Text Formatter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/text-formatter/): Add line numbers, wrap text at a column, add prefixes and suffixes, indent, and turn lines into a bulleted or numbered list.
- [List Processor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/list-processor/): Sort, deduplicate, filter and compare a list of items — alphabetically, naturally, by length, numerically, and against a second list.
- [Text Splitter & Joiner](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/text-splitter/): Split text into lines, paragraphs, sentences, batches of characters or words, or a fixed number of parts — then join it back together.
- [Find and Replace](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/find-and-replace/): Find and replace text with optional regular expressions, case and whole-word matching, match counting and safe capture-group substitution.
- [Text Diff](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/text-diff/): Compare two texts line by line or word by word, with an accurate diff, ignore options, and differences marked by sign, tint and word.
- [Text Truncator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/text-truncator/): Shorten text to a limit in characters, words, sentences, lines or paragraphs — cutting at a word boundary and counting the suffix inside the limit.
- [Placeholder Text Generator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/lorem-ipsum/): Generate placeholder text by paragraph, sentence or word count, with or without the traditional opening, and repeatably when you need the same text twice.
- [Emoji Picker](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/emoji-picker/): Search and copy emoji from a set bundled with the page — no API call, no tracking, and the picker keeps working offline once the page has loaded.
- [Code Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/code-editor/): Write a code snippet in the browser, highlight it in your language, share it as a link that carries the code, and save it as a PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
- [SQL Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/sql-editor/): Write and run SQLite in the browser: build a database from a schema script or open a .sqlite file, read results as a table, and save the database back out.
- [Mermaid Diagram Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/mermaid-diagram-editor/): Write Mermaid source, watch it render as a live diagram, and download it as a PNG file, all in your browser.
- [Lua Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/lua-editor/): Write and run Lua 5.4 in the browser with WebAssembly: a full editor with syntax highlighting, REPL console, examples and execution limits. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Pseudocode Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/pseudocode-editor/): Write, run and inspect Cambridge 9618 pseudocode in your browser. Insert ready-made blocks, load 36 examples, and watch output and variables update.
- [Brainfuck Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/brainfuck-editor/): Write and execute Brainfuck in the browser with an interactive editor and execution controls. An esoteric, minimalist, Turing-complete language with 8 commands.
- [HTTP Status Codes](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/http-status-codes/): A searchable reference for every HTTP status code, with plain-English explanations, categories, and related-code links. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [JSON Formatter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/json-formatter/): Validate, format and minify JSON in your browser, with syntax errors reported as a line and a column you can find.
- [JSON YAML Converter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/json-yaml-converter/): Convert JSON to YAML and YAML to JSON in your browser, with configurable indentation and errors that say where to look.
- [YAML Formatter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/yaml-formatter/): Validate and format YAML in your browser, with parser errors reported as a line and a column you can find.
- [XML to JSON Converter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/xml-to-json/): Convert XML documents to JSON in your browser, with a documented mapping for attributes, repeated elements and mixed content.
- [Front Matter Editor](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/front-matter-editor/): Extract, edit and convert the Front Matter metadata block at the top of a Markdown document, then rebuild the document around it.
- [Binary Converter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/binary-converter/): Convert between binary, decimal, octal and hexadecimal; encode and decode text and Base64, and calculate with binary arithmetic and bitwise shifts.
- [Encryption](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/encryption/): Encrypt and decrypt text in your browser with AES-256-GCM or the OpenSSL-compatible AES-256-CBC format.
- [Hash Text](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/hash-text/): Hash text with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-512 or RIPEMD-160, entirely in your browser.
- [Token Generator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/token-generator/): Generate cryptographically secure random tokens in your browser, with the length and the character sets you choose.
- [ULID Generator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/ulid-generator/): Generate universally unique lexicographically sortable identifiers in your browser, with the count you need.
- [Cipher Toolkit](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/cipher-toolkit/): Fourteen classical ciphers in one place. Choose a cipher, set its key, and encrypt or decrypt text with the algorithm running entirely in your browser.
- [Time Difference Calculator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/time-difference-calculator/): Compare local times, daylight, and time differences across the cities that matter wherever you travel.
- [The World Clock](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/world-clock/): A live clock for every city that matters to you — the current time, date, and daylight for your city and anywhere your people are, all at once.
- [Currency Converter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/currency-converter/): Convert between currencies using reference exchange rates from a reputable public data source, with the rate and its date shown.
- [Unit Converter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/unit-converter/): Convert length, weight, temperature, volume, area, speed, fuel economy and data transfer rates between metric, US and Imperial units.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/percentage-calculator/): Calculate a percentage of a number, what percentage one number is of another, percentage change, adding or subtracting a percentage, and percentage difference.
- [GPS Coordinate Converter](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/gps-coordinate-converter/): Convert GPS coordinates between decimal degrees, degrees and decimal minutes, and degrees, minutes and seconds, with validation of ranges.
- [Speed, Distance, and Time Calculator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/speed-distance-time-calculator/): Calculate speed, distance or time from the other two, with consistent unit conversion for metric and imperial units.
- [QR Code Generator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/qr-code-generator/): Create custom QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi, contacts, email, phone numbers, locations — with customizable colors, styles and logos.
- [Favicon Generator](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/favicon-generator/): Generate favicons and app icons in your browser from text or an image. Export PNGs, a multi-resolution ICO, ZIP, manifest, and HTML tags. Nothing is uploaded.
- [YouTube on Repeat](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/youtube-on-repeat/): Paste a YouTube URL and loop the whole video or a precise A–B section, with playback-speed control and keyboard shortcuts. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [2048](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/2048/): Slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid, merging equal tiles to reach 2048. A free, offline browser game with keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- [Battleships](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/battleships/): The classic fleet-hunting game, no-touch edition. Place five ships with a cell of water between each, trade shots with a probability-hunting computer opponent.
- [Catch the Cat](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/catch-the-cat/): The classic trapping puzzle. Place barriers on a hexagonal grid while the cat takes one step per turn toward the edge. Trap it before it escapes.
- [Dots and Boxes](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/dots-and-boxes/): The classic paper-and-pencil strategy game. Draw lines, complete boxes, earn extra turns, and outmaneuver the computer or a friend on boards up to 10×10.
- [Lights Out](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/lights-out/): Turn every light off. Tap a light to toggle it and its four neighbors. Random solvable puzzles, multiple board sizes, hints, undo, timer and personal bests.
- [Memory Game](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/memory-game/): Test your memory with this classic card matching game. Multiple difficulties, themes, and game modes. Play offline on flights, trains, and during travel.
- [Nim](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/nim/): The classic mathematical strategy game. Take turns removing objects from heaps, master the XOR nim-sum, and challenge the Optimal computer opponent.
- [Rock Paper Scissors](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/rock-paper-scissors/): Play Rock Paper Scissors against the computer. A free, mobile-friendly browser game for quick breaks on trains, airplanes, and during travel.
- [Simon](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/simon/): Watch the colored pads light up in a growing sequence, then repeat it exactly. Each round adds one more step; one wrong tap ends the game.
- [State Conquest](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/state-conquest/): A turn-based territory-conquest strategy game. Command garrisons, capture strongholds, and eliminate rival commanders across tactical theaters.
- [Tic-Tac-Toe](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/tic-tac-toe/): Play Tic-Tac-Toe against an optimal computer opponent or challenge a friend on the same device. A free, mobile-friendly browser game for quick breaks.
- [Tower of Hanoi](https://app.sergeyromanenko.com/tower-of-hanoi/): Solve the classic Tower of Hanoi puzzle. Move disks between three pegs following the rules, with difficulty levels, move counter, hints and a solution mode.
